# gME2 workspace guidance

- Keep the frontend in React and TypeScript; use the existing Vite setup and CSS conventions.
- Preserve keyboard accessibility, responsive behavior, and reduced-motion support when changing the game interface.
- Keep starter narrative material non-explicit and update mature-content disclosures when replacing placeholder story copy.
- Run `npm run lint` and `npm run build` after meaningful changes.
- Do not add external media or services without explicit project requirements.
